title: Count Distinct Subsequences
description: Given lowercase strings `s` and `t`, count the different ways to delete characters from `s` without changing the order of the remaining characters so that the result equals `t`. Return the count modulo 1,000,000,007. Input: `s`, `t`. Output: the number of index choices modulo the stated modulus.
constraints: s and t contain lowercase English letters
hints: Track only the character counts or prefixes needed to decide the next step.
Check repeated symbols, empty or minimal cases, and impossible arrangements.
